topics.label: Introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic frames the lecture by connecting to practical histopathology work and outlining the intended learning outcomes.

topics.label: Viral oncogenesis, proto-oncogenes, and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the study of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and led to laboratory assays measuring cell transformation.

topics.label: Functional classification and mechanisms of cancer mutations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer-associated genes are categorised into oncogenes or tumor suppressors and examine their functional behaviour across pathways and allele dosage variations.

topics.label: Forms and mechanistic causes of genetic instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how deficiencies in distinct DNA repair pathways, replication proofreading, and mitotic segregation generate sequence and chromosome instability.

topics.label: Multi-step tumor progression and hereditary cancer predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cumulative mutations and inherited germline defects accelerate the multistep evolution of cancer.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and reading recommendations
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic concludes the session with book recommendations and a preview of the next lecture.
